say:2:1010204001:0.text: With everything that's been happening recently, can't you just be good and stay in the village?
say:2:1010204001:0.source_cn: 最近这么多变数，你就不能乖乖待在村子里吗！

say:3:1010204002:0.text: No! Malcolm said the lake's frozen over. I have to go see it! You may not care, Grandpa, but I've never seen a frozen lake.
say:3:1010204002:0.source_cn: 我不！马尔科姆他们说映湖结冰了，我一定要去看看！爷爷你...

say:4:1010204003:0.text:
You don't understand anything!
That just means it's cold, and what's so good about that?
say:4:1010204003:0.source_cn: 你什么都不懂！\n结冰意味着降温，寒冷有什么好？

say:5:1010204004:0.text: Those Northville folks refuse to listen to Lord Franz's advice, and even Merlin's magic can't protect them anymore. I forbid you from going to Northville!
